ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p177/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p177/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p177/r4.claim: The threat that Noah would be among the stoned may mean stones hurled at him or verbal abuse.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p177/r4.anchor: لتكونن من المرجومين، أي بالحجارة. وقيل: بالشتم

RAZI-FULL:v24p133#2/r11.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v24p133#2/r11.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v24p133#2/r11.claim: The people threaten to kill Noah by stoning him; at this point he despairs of their salvation and asks God to judge between them.
RAZI-FULL:v24p133#2/r11.anchor: والمعنى أنهم خوفوه بأن يقتل بالحجارة

BURSEVI:v6p212#2/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p212#2/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p212#2/r5.claim: Noah’s people threaten him unless he stops preaching and warning.
BURSEVI:v6p212#2/r5.anchor: عما تقول يعني عن الدعوة والإنذار.

BURSEVI:v6p212#2/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p212#2/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p212#2/r6.claim: Intihāʾ means to stop or desist.
BURSEVI:v6p212#2/r6.anchor:
عما تقول يعني عن الدعوة والإنذار.
والانتهاء (بازاستيدن).

BURSEVI:v6p212#2/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p212#2/r7.speaker: الراغب
BURSEVI:v6p212#2/r7.claim: Al-Rāghib says rajam is throwing stones, and construes the threat as a promise to kill Noah in the ugliest manner.
BURSEVI:v6p212#2/r7.anchor: قال الراغب في "المفردات" : الرجام الحجارة والرجم الرمي بالرجام يقال : رجم فهو مرجوم

RAZI-FULL:v1p61/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v1p61/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v1p61/r6.claim: Alternatively, Satan is called rajim because God ordered angels to drive devils from the heavens with meteors; the description then extends to every evil rebel.
RAZI-FULL:v1p61/r6.anchor: أن الشيطان إنما وصف بكونه مرجوما لأنه تعالى أمر الملائكة برمي الشياطين بالشهب والثواقب طردا لهم من السموات

STUDYQURAN:26:116/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:26:116/r1.speaker: Q, R
STUDYQURAN:26:116/r1.claim: The disbelievers threaten to stone Noah to death for denigrating their gods and religion.
STUDYQURAN:26:116/r1.anchor: The disbelievers say they will stone Noah to death (R) for denigrating their gods and their religion (Q).

STUDYQURAN:26:116/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:26:116/r2.speaker: some commentators (Q, Ṭ)
STUDYQURAN:26:116/r2.claim: Some take stoned to mean abuse and vilification rather than literal stoning, as in Satan called al-rajīm, usually understood as accursed.
STUDYQURAN:26:116/r2.anchor: but abuse and vilification (Q, Ṭ), as in the phrase

STUDYQURAN:26:116/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:26:116/r3.speaker: al-Qurṭubī
STUDYQURAN:26:116/r3.claim: Al-Qurṭubī cites Abraham's father's threat in 19:46 as an example where stoning is metaphorical rather than literal.
STUDYQURAN:26:116/r3.anchor: Al-Qurṭubī points to the example of “stoning” in the words spoken by Abraham’s father to him in 19:46

TAB-FULL:v17p603/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v17p603/r3.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v17p603/r3.claim: Noah’s people threaten to make him one of the reviled, meaning they will insult him.

TABATABAI:26:111-118/r9.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:26:111-118/r9.speaker: author
TABATABAI:26:111-118/r9.claim: Their demand that Noah desist means that he stop preaching; rujm means stoning, and this threat marks the last stage of their dealings with him.
TABATABAI:26:111-118/r9.anchor: المراد بالانتهاء ترك الدعوة، والرجم هو الرمي بالحجارة

TABATABAI:26:111-118/r10.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:26:111-118/r10.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:26:111-118/r10.claim: A view takes rujm figuratively as verbal abuse, but al-Tabatabai calls that interpretation remote.
TABATABAI:26:111-118/r10.anchor: وقيل المراد به الشتم وهو بعيد

TABATABAI:26:111-118/r11.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:26:111-118/r11.speaker: author
TABATABAI:26:111-118/r11.claim: The threat is phrased as a firm, emphatic assertion, matching the final and forceful character of their warning.
TABATABAI:26:111-118/r11.anchor: يهددونه عليه السلام بقول جازم كما يشهد به ما في الكلام من وجوه التأكيد

TABRISI:26:105-111/r7.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:26:105-111/r7.speaker: author
TABRISI:26:105-111/r7.claim: Rajm is throwing stones, not shooting with a bow; a reviled person is called marjūm because people cast blame at him.
TABRISI:26:105-111/r7.anchor: والرجم الرمي بالحجارة ولا يقال للرمي بالقوس رجم ويسمى المشتوم مرجوما لأنه

TABRISI:26:105-111/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:26:105-111/r8.speaker: author
TABRISI:26:105-111/r8.claim: Intihāʾ is reaching a limit without going beyond the point at which one was forbidden; nihāya is reaching a limit.
TABRISI:26:105-111/r8.anchor: والانتهاء بلوغ الحد من غير مجاوزة إلى ما وقع عنه النهي وأصل النهاية بلوغ الحد

TABRISI:26:112-122/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:26:112-122/r8.speaker: author
TABRISI:26:112-122/r8.claim: Their condition means that if Noah does not desist from what he says and calls them to, he will be punished.
TABRISI:26:112-122/r8.anchor: أي إن لم ترجع عما تقوله وتدعو إليه

TABRISI:26:112-122/r9.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:26:112-122/r9.speaker: قتادة
TABRISI:26:112-122/r9.claim: Qatada says they threatened to stone Noah.
TABRISI:26:112-122/r9.anchor: لتكونن من المرجومين } بالحجارة عن قتادة.

TABRISI:26:112-122/r10.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:26:112-122/r10.speaker: الضحاك
TABRISI:26:112-122/r10.claim: Al-Dahhak says they threatened to revile Noah.
TABRISI:26:112-122/r10.anchor: وقيل: من المرجومين بالشتم عن الضحاك

THALABI:v7p173/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v7p173/r2.speaker: الضحاك
THALABI:v7p173/r2.claim: Al-Dahhak interprets marjumin as people marked by ill omen or misfortune.
THALABI:v7p173/r2.anchor: يعني المشؤومين عن الضحاك، قتادة: المضروبين بالحجارة

THALABI:v7p173/r3.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v7p173/r3.speaker: قتادة
THALABI:v7p173/r3.claim: Qatada interprets marjumin as people struck with stones.
THALABI:v7p173/r3.anchor: عن الضحاك، قتادة: المضروبين بالحجارة. قال ابن عباس ومقاتل

THALABI:v7p173/r4.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v7p173/r4.speaker: ابن عباس، مقاتل
THALABI:v7p173/r4.claim: Ibn Abbas and Muqatil take the threat to mean that Noah would be killed.
THALABI:v7p173/r4.anchor: قال ابن عباس ومقاتل: من المقتولين. الثمالي: كل شيء في القرآن

THALABI:v7p173/r5.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v7p173/r5.speaker: الثمالي
THALABI:v7p173/r5.claim: Al-Thumali says Quranic references to being stoned generally mean killing, except the threat in Maryam, where the word means “I will insult you.”
THALABI:v7p173/r5.anchor: الثمالي: كل شيء في القرآن من ذكر المرجومين فإنه يعني بذلك القتل إلا التي في سورة مريم

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#5/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#5/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#5/r1.claim: The threat means: if Noah does not stop speaking and keep quiet.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#5/r1.anchor: قالوا لئن لم تنته يا نوح

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#5/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#5/r2.speaker: ابن عباس ومقاتل والكلبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#5/r2.claim: Al-marjūmīn means those who are killed.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#5/r2.anchor: قال ابن عباس، ومقاتل، والكلبي: من المقتولين

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#5/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#5/r3.speaker: الضحاك
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#5/r3.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk interprets it as those insulted or reviled.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#5/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#5/r4.speaker: قتادة
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p86#5/r4.claim: Qatāda interprets it as those pelted with stones.

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:26:116/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:26:116/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:26:116/r1.claim: Al-marjūmīn can mean those who are insulted; another reported meaning is those who are killed.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:26:116/r1.anchor: أي: من المشتومين. وقيل: من المقتولين

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512#2/r4.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512#2/r4.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512#2/r4.claim: Noah’s opponents demand that he stop calling them and insulting their gods, then threaten to stone him.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512#2/r4.anchor: قالوا لئن لم تنته يا نوح} [الشعراء: 115-116] عما تدعونا إليه، وعن ذم آلهتنا وشتمها.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512#2/r5.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512#2/r5.speaker: قتادة
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512#2/r5.claim: Qatāda says stoning means they will kill Noah with stones.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512#2/r5.anchor: {لتكونن من المرجومين} [الشعراء: 116] قال قتادة: بالحجارة، فلنقتلنك بها.

ELMALILI:26:105-122/r10.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:26:105-122/r10.speaker: author
ELMALILI:26:105-122/r10.claim: His people swear that unless he stops, Noah will certainly be among those stoned.
ELMALILI:26:105-122/r10.anchor: eğer vazgeçmezsen yâ Nûh, mutlak ve muhakkak recm edilenlerden olacaksın” (116).

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.claim: Noah’s call has the same essential principles as Moses’s and Abraham’s, and their peoples’ beliefs and responses to true religion were alike; the three narrative groups deliver the same message.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.anchor: Sonuç itibariyle her üç peygambere dair âyetler grubunda da aynı mesajlar verilmiştir

ZAJJAJ:v4p95#2/r1.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p95#2/r1.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p95#2/r1.claim: The threatened punishment is stoning with rocks.

ASAD-NOTES:26:116#n51/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:26:116#n51/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:26:116#n51/r1.claim: The literal threat says Noah will surely be among those stoned to death.
ASAD-NOTES:26:116#n51/r1.anchor: Lit., "thou wilt surely be among those who are stoned [to death)".

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p429/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p429/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p429/r2.claim: The wording indicates that Noah had already been threatened with stoning and ignored it; now the nation declares emphatically that the threat will be carried out.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p429/r2.anchor: earlier on too they had threatened to stone Noah (sws) to death but he ignored them.

ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#3/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#3/r1.speaker: قتادة
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#3/r1.claim: Qatada explains المرجومين as people pelted with stones.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#3/r1.anchor: أي المرميين بالحجارة كما روي عن قتادة

ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#3/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#3/r2.speaker: الحسن
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#3/r2.claim: Al-Hasan says the threat of stoning is a threat to kill Noah.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#3/r2.anchor: وهو توعد بالقتل كما روي عن الحسن

ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#3/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#3/r3.speaker: السدي
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#3/r3.claim: Al-Suddi, in a report from Ibn Abi Hatim, interprets the threat as being among the insulted; stoning is metaphorical for abuse, as in taunting.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#3/r3.anchor: وأخرج ابن أبي حاتم عن السدي أن المعنى من المشتومين على أن الرجم مستعار للشتم كالطعن

ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#3/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#3/r4.speaker: إرشاد العقل السليم
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#3/r4.claim: Irshad al-Aql al-Salim says they made this threat near the end of the affair.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p108#3/r4.anchor: وفي ارشاد العقل السليم أنهم قاتلهم الله تعالى قالوا ذلك في أواخر الأمر

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r13.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r13.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r13.claim: Noah's opponents threaten him if he does not stop what he is saying.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r13.anchor: قالوا لئن لم تنته يا نوح} عما تقول، {لتكونن من المرجومين}

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r14.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r14.speaker: مقاتل والكلبي
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r14.claim: Muqatil and al-Kalbi interpret the threat as being killed by stones.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r14.anchor: قال مقاتل والكلبي: من المقتولين بالحجارة.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r15.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r15.speaker: الضحاك
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r15.claim: Al-Dahhak interprets the threat as being verbally abused.

BAYDAWI-FULL:26:115-119/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:115-119/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:115-119/r2.claim: The threatened stoning may mean being insulted or struck with stones.

BIQAI-FULL:v5p374/r13.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p374/r13.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p374/r13.claim: When Noah rejects their demand to expel the followers, they abandon their deceptive inducement and threaten him with death by stoning.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p374/r13.anchor: ولما أياسهم مما أرادوا من طرد أتباعه

BIQAI-FULL:v5p374/r14.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p374/r14.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p374/r14.claim: Addressing him by his name instead of a respectful title signals their rudeness and lack of manners.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p374/r14.anchor: ثم سموه باسمه جفاء وقلة أدب

BIQAI-FULL:v5p374/r15.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p374/r15.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p374/r15.claim: Here al-mujrimīn means those to be killed, and Noah’s weak followers will not be able to protect him.

IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r1.speaker: الحسن
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r1.claim: Hasan says Noah's opponents threatened to kill him; a similar gloss is reported from Zayd ibn Aslam.
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r1.anchor: الحسن في قوله : لتكونن من المرجومين قال : تواعدوه

IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r2.speaker: زيد بن أسلم
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r2.claim: Zayd ibn Aslam is also reported to explain the threat as a promise of killing.
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r2.anchor: عن زيد بن اسلم نحو ذلك

IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r3.speaker: قتادة
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r3.claim: Qatada takes the threat literally as stoning with stones.
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r3.anchor: قتادة قوله : لئن لم تنته يا نوح

IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r4.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r4.speaker: السدي
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r4.claim: Al-Suddi explains being stoned as being abused with insults.
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r4.anchor: السدي قوله لئن لم تنته لتكونن من المرجومين ، يقول : بالشتيمهة

IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r5.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r5.speaker: عبد بن عمير الليثي
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r5.claim: A report from Abd ibn Umayr says Noah's people attacked and strangled him until he fainted; on recovering, he prayed, Lord, forgive my people, for they do not know.
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2789#4/r5.anchor: عبد بن عمير الليثي انه كان يحدث انه بلغه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p163/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p163/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p163/r1.claim: When argument failed, Noah’s opponents resorted to the bullies’ weapon: threatening physical harm.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p163/r1.anchor: صاروا إلى سلاح المبطلين وهو المناضلة بالأذى

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p163/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p163/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p163/r2.claim: Rجم means throwing stones and commonly means killing by stoning; من المرجومين places Noah in a class of people deserving that punishment.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p163/r2.anchor: الرمي بالحجارة ، وقد غلب استعماله في القتل به

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p163/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p163/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p163/r3.claim: The construction is like Noah’s words in al-Anʿām, وما أنا من المهتدين, which likewise identifies a person as belonging to a class.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p163/r3.anchor: كما تقدم في قوله : { وما أنا من المهتدين } في سورة الأنعام

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p236#2/r17.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p236#2/r17.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p236#2/r17.claim: The threat may mean stoning with rocks or verbal abuse and slander likened to stoning.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p236#2/r17.anchor: وقولهم من المرجومين، يحتمل أن يريدوا بالحجارة، ويحتمل أن يريدوا بالقول والشتم ونحوه

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p151#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p151#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p151#2/r1.claim: Noah had called his people persistently by night and day, openly and privately, but each repeated call met hardened unbelief and resistance.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p151#2/r1.anchor: لما طال مقام نبي الله بين أظهرهم يدعوهم إلى الله ليلا ونهارا، وجهرا وإسرارا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p151#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p151#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p151#2/r2.claim: The people threatened to stone Noah if he stopped summoning them to his religion.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p151#2/r2.anchor: أي: عن دعوتك إيانا إلى دينك يا نوح

JISHUMI:v7p5370/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5370/r7.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5370/r7.claim: Ṭard is expulsion or banishment; طرده and أطرده mean he drove him away or made him an outcast.
JISHUMI:v7p5370/r7.anchor: والطرد: الإبعاد، طرده طردا وأطرده: جعله طريدا.

JISHUMI:v7p5370/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5370/r8.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5370/r8.claim: Rajm is throwing stones, not shooting arrows; al-marjūm can also mean one reviled, as if pelted with blame.
JISHUMI:v7p5370/r8.anchor: والرجم: الرمي بالحجارة، لا يقال للرمي بالسهم رجم، والمرجوم: المشتوم

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p179#2/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p179#2/r1.speaker: قتادة
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p179#2/r1.claim: Qatada says the threatened rajm is stoning with stones.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p179#2/r1.anchor: أحدها : بالحجارة ، قاله قتادة . الثاني : بالقتل

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p179#2/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p179#2/r2.speaker: محمد بن الحسن
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p179#2/r2.claim: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan interprets the threat as killing.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p179#2/r2.anchor: الثاني : بالقتل ، قاله محمد بن الحسن . الثالث : بالشتيمة

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p179#2/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p179#2/r3.speaker: السدي
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p179#2/r3.claim: Al-Suddi interprets the threat as verbal abuse.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p179#2/r3.anchor: الثالث : بالشتيمة ، قاله السدي . قال أبو داود :

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p179#2/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p179#2/r4.speaker: أبو داود
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p179#2/r4.claim: Abu Dawud's poetic line uses tarajmunī for the threatened act, serving as evidence for the word's usage.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p179#2/r4.anchor: قال أبو داود : صدت غواة معد أن تراجمني … كما يصدون عن لب كجفان

MUQATIL:26:112-118/r6.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:26:112-118/r6.speaker: author
MUQATIL:26:112-118/r6.claim: “If you do not desist” means “if you do not stop speaking to us.”
MUQATIL:26:112-118/r6.anchor: يعنى لئن لم تسكت { ينوح } عنا

MUQATIL:26:112-118/r7.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:26:112-118/r7.speaker: author
MUQATIL:26:112-118/r7.claim: The threat to stone Noah means they would kill him.

NASAFI-FULL:v3p192#5/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p192#5/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p192#5/r1.claim: They tell Noah to stop what he is saying.

NASAFI-FULL:v3p192#5/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p192#5/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p192#5/r2.claim: They threaten that he will be among those killed by stoning.

QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r13.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r13.claim: The threat is for Noah to stop reviling their gods and criticizing their religion.
QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r13.anchor: قوله تعالى: { قالوا لئن لم تنته ينوح } أي عن سب آلهتنا وعيب ديننا

QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r14.speaker: قتادة
QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r14.claim: Qatāda takes “among the stoned” literally: they threatened to stone Noah.
QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r14.anchor: { لتكونن من المرجومين } أي بالحجارة قاله قتادة.

QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r15.speaker: ابن عباس ومقاتل
QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r15.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās and Muqātil interpret “the stoned” as those killed.
QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r15.anchor: وقال ابن عباس ومقاتل: من المقتولين.

QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r16.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r16.speaker: الثمالي
QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r16.claim: Al-Thumālī says “stoned” means killed throughout the Qur’an except at 19:46, where it means insulted.
QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r16.anchor: قال الثمالي: كل مرجومين في القرآن فهو القتل إلا في «مريم»:

QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r17.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r17.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r17.claim: The Maryam exception is where “I will stone you” means “I will insult you.”
QURTUBI-FULL:26:112-116/r17.anchor: قال الثمالي: كل مرجومين في القرآن فهو القتل إلا في «مريم»:

QURTUBI-FULL:26:116-122/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:116-122/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:26:116-122/r1.claim: At 19:46, Abraham’s father’s threat uses “stone” in the sense of verbal abuse.
QURTUBI-FULL:26:116-122/r1.anchor: لئن لم تنته لأرجمنك [مريم: 46] أي لأسبنك

QURTUBI-FULL:26:116-122/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:116-122/r2.speaker: السدي
QURTUBI-FULL:26:116-122/r2.claim: Al-Suddī also interprets the threat as being among those verbally abused.
QURTUBI-FULL:26:116-122/r2.anchor: وقيل: { من المرجومين } من المشتومين قاله السدي.
